name: Unarmed Strike
summary: Default no-gear attack; Street Fighters and Fist Fighters make especially good use of it.

name: Improvised Club
summary: A rough close-combat weapon suitable for Street Fighters and desperate brawls.

name: Pistol
summary: A firearm that uses Agility for attacks and benefits from the Firearms skill.
notes: Reloading costs 2 AP if your table uses the Firearms skill text from the common skills section.

name: Rifle
summary: A disciplined ranged weapon favoured by Green Jackets.
notes: Reloading costs 2 AP if your table uses the Firearms skill text from the common skills section.

name: Armoured Tunic
summary: Light armour used in the handbook combat example.

name: Leather Coat
summary: Light armour suitable for agile or lightly-equipped classes.

name: Boilerplate Coat
summary: A heavier protective coat with stronger armour but more style or class restrictions.

name: Medical Kit
summary: Without the Healer skill it can restore only 1 HP; with training it scales by kit quality and healer expertise.
